name: MemProcFS
description: Mount a memory image as a file system and browse processes, handles and network activity as files.
about: MemProcFS presents a memory image the way an operating system presents a disk: as a tree of directories and files. Each process becomes a folder holding its modules, handles, threads, virtual memory map and recovered files, so examining memory becomes reading and copying rather than running a query and interpreting a table. It reads raw dumps, crash dumps and hibernation files, and can also attach to live memory through a driver. A plugin directory extends what appears in the tree, and a bundled rule engine allows scanning the mounted image for known patterns. Mounting it as a drive letter needs a file system driver installed separately; without one the same data is reachable through its other interfaces.
